description: This file contains helper functions for cellular management, including JSON-like message unpacking with msgpack, and functions for finding map elements and converting data structures. It is part of a cellular management component in a larger project.

methods.name: comp_helper_convert
methods.description: Converts a buffer into a structured data type using msgpack unpacking, with support for optional parameters and custom processing/destroy functions.

methods.name: __finder_comp
methods.description: Finds a map element by name and expected type within a msgpack map object.
